content.title: Peloton Slides After Hiking Prices in Sweeping Product Revamp
content.summary: The new products, announced Wednesday, include new versions of the Bike and Bike+, Tread and Tread+ and the replacement of the Row with a Row+, confirming an August Bloomberg report.  To go along with the new models, Peloton is implementing significant price increases, with an average bump of around 11% for hardware and 19% for the subscription fees.  “We know that every dollar is precious and people are considering how to spend their money these days," Chief Executive Officer Peter Stern said in an interview with Bloomberg Television.

content.title: Peloton stock falls on product revamp, Nike's turnaround traction
content.description:
Yahoo Finance's John Hyland tracks Wednesday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute.

The government shutdown will delay Friday's September job report. Meanwhile, ADP jobs data showed a loss of 32,000 private jobs in September.

Nike (NKE) stock is gaining on the company's first quarter earnings beat, showing traction in its turnaround plan.

Peloton (PTON) stock is falling after the company revealed its revamped products and price hikes.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
